subtitle.en: Dhyana + 30 names · not the full thousand

edition.notes: Doorway to the Vishnu Sahasranama (Mahabharata Anushasana Parva class). Opening dhyana Shantakaram plus thirty public names. Not a dump of one thousand. Meanings provisional.

description.hi: सहस्रनाम का द्वार — शान्ताकारं ध्यान और तीस नाम। पूरी सूची नहीं।
description.en: A doorway to the sahasranama — the Shantakaram dhyana and thirty names. Not the full list.
